prompt: Summarize what was decided in the following meeting notes, in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: In the kickoff meeting for the Northwind Logistics RFP response on March 14, it was decided to implement a three-phase rollout beginning with a discovery phase in April, followed by a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May, and a decision gate before broader deployment. Key logistics were confirmed, including the availability of the depot and the assignment of two part-time coordinators, while budget considerations for the initial phase could reach $50,000, subject to finance committee review of pilot outcomes in June. Action items were established, including a revised schedule and documentation of the integration approach.
